title: arashouse flavors --json
description: One entry per flavor, in registry order: what it is, the libs-js engine to use with it, its slot counts, and whether its media and a verified baseline are present.

release.description: The Aras release the key stands for, for example Release 23 (14.0 SP9).

aras.description: The server build, for example 14.0.9.36073; null until the flavor's baseline has been built.

engine.description: The import-export-libs-js --engine for this server; `run` sets it as ARAS_PKG_ENGINE.

media.description: Every expected installer file is in media/<flavor>/, loose or inside a CD-image zip; null when the media folder cannot be found.

baseline.description: The golden baseline verifies (fast level); null when the host could not be asked.
